notes.adaptive_limitation: Scrapling auto_save stores the first element's fingerprint only; adaptive relocate recovers that intended node after class rename, it is not a drop-in replacement for listing every sibling card.

live_observations.cic: HTTP 200 (~140 KB) but both production and shadow extracted 0 events without JS rendering. Consistent with a JS-rendered listing; production already has a Playwright retry. This pilot did not use a browser.
live_observations.hkie_cpd: HTTP 200; production and shadow both extracted 10 events with exact title/date/URL agreement.
live_observations.hkgbc: HTTP 200 (~1 MB, ~24s). Production parser caps at 40 events; all 40 matched shadow titles/dates/URLs. Shadow also produced 902 additional unique title+date candidates on the live listing that need review before any production use (fixture comparison remains 7/7 exact).

honest_assessment: Worth keeping in shadow for DOM-resilience experiments, not ready to migrate production parsers. Adaptive relocate recovered the correct CIC and HKIE cards after a class/wrapper rename, but: (1) Scrapling stores only the first element's fingerprint, so it does not re-list sibling cards; (2) CIC and HKGBC adaptive matching can return a similar sidebar or a different event card (false positive, worse than failure); (3) live CIC still needs JS to see cards; (4) live HKGBC over-extracts versus the production cap. Registration-channel wording was not used as attendance mode.
